highlights: 1.6.13 修复：2026-11-24 起 muse.ai 的视频服务时常返回“过载（503）/暂时不可用”，以前这种回复被当成模型拒绝，任务直接失败。现在会识别为临时故障，等待 20 秒后换号重试（默认最多再试 3 次，受生成时限约束）；重试仍失败时返回“Muse 媒体服务暂时不可用”而不是笼统的超时。
真正的拒绝（内容政策、地区不支持、额度不足）仍立即失败，不换号。新增环境变量 MUSE2API_BUSY_RETRIES / MUSE2API_BUSY_RETRY_DELAY / MUSE2API_BUSY_RETRY_MIN_REMAINING。无需升级浏览器插件。
highlights_en: 1.6.13 fix: since 2026-11-24 muse.ai's video service often answers "overloaded (503) / temporarily unavailable". That reply used to be treated as a model refusal and failed the task at once. It is now recognised as a temporary outage and retried on another account after 20 s (up to 3 extra attempts by default, within the generation time limit). If the retries still fail, the task reports the outage instead of a generic timeout.

Real refusals (content policy, unsupported region, no credits) still fail immediately without rotating. New settings: MUSE2API_BUSY_RETRIES / MUSE2API_BUSY_RETRY_DELAY / MUSE2API_BUSY_RETRY_MIN_REMAINING. No extension upgrade is needed.
